as_told.title: McDonnell Douglas parapsychology program at Washington University St. Louis

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the big aerospace company McDonnell Douglas ran a parapsychology program, meaning research into things like telepathy and other mind powers, tied to Washington University in St. Louis, Missouri. In one telling he says the company's founder, James McDonnell, set up the institute in the 1960s and was close to Bob Jahn, Princeton's dean of engineering, who went on to start a lab at Princeton that studied anomalies. If true, it would mean serious aerospace money was quietly backing research into the mind.
